title: Synthesis, structural characterization, antioxidant, cytotoxic activities and docking studies of schiff base Cu(II) complexes.
authors: Rezk, Ghada N; El-Gammal, Ola A; Alrefaee, Salhah H; Althagafi, Ismail; El-Bindary, Ashraf A; El-Bindary, Mohamed A
one_liner_zh: 该文合成并表征了Schiff碱铜(II)配合物，仅通过光谱和粘度法初步考察其与DNA的结合，并用分子对接研究其与SARS-CoV-2蛋白及乳腺癌蛋白的相互作用，对象非蛋白质-DNA互作核心，方法为简单对接，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: By combining hydrazide with 2-Acetylpyridine, a hydrazone ligand (HL) was successfully created. Several copper (II) salts have been used to create three copper (II) hydrazone complexes (acetate, sulphate, and chloride). The hydrazide ligand and its copper (II) complexes (1-3) were studied via variety of analytical techniques, including elemental analysis, electronic, infrared, UV-vis Spectrum, XRD study, thermal analysis, also molar conductivity amounts. The spectrum results indicate that in all complexes, the ligand exhibits monobasic tridentate behavior. Octahedral geometries were present in all metal complexes. The Coats-Redfern equations were used to compute and describe the dynamics properties of several steps of TGA (Ea, A, DeltaH*, DeltaS*, and DeltaG*). Calculations using the density functional theory (DFT) were done at the molecular studio software toward examine ligands agent's and its complexes' best structures. The MCF-7 in addition to HepG-2 cell lines was resistant to tumor-inducing effects of the copper (II) chelates. The in vitro antioxidant capacities of all complexes have been estimated via DPPH free radical scavenger assays. Furthermore, zones of inhibition length accustomed to test antimicrobial effect of particular complexes in vitro towards Staphylococcus aureus (Gram positive bacteria) E. coli (Gram negative bacteria). Both absorption spectra and viscosity measurements in calf thymus DNA binding have been used to study the complexes. In order to explore docking research of copper (II) chelates, the crystallographic construction of the SARS-active CoV-2's site protein (PDB ID:6XBH) was used (COVID-19) and breast cancer distorted (PDB ID: 3hb5).
abstract_zh: 通过将酰肼与2-乙酰吡啶结合，成功制备了一种腙配体（HL）。使用多种铜（II）盐（醋酸盐、硫酸盐和氯化物）合成了三种铜（II）腙配合物。通过多种分析技术研究了酰肼配体及其铜（II）配合物（1-3），包括元素分析、电子光谱、红外光谱、紫外-可见光谱、XRD研究、热分析以及摩尔电导率值。光谱结果表明，在所有配合物中，配体表现出单碱三齿行为。所有金属配合物均呈现八面体几何构型。使用Coats-Redfern方程计算并描述了TGA各步骤的动力学性质（Ea、A、DeltaH*、DeltaS*和DeltaG*）。在分子工作室软件中进行了密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，以考察配体及其配合物的最佳结构。MCF-7和HepG-2细胞系对铜（II）螯合物的肿瘤诱导效应具有抗性。通过DPPH自由基清除实验评估了所有配合物的体外抗氧化能力。此外，测量抑菌圈长度以测试特定配合物对金黄色葡萄球菌（革兰氏阳性菌）和大肠杆菌（革兰氏阴性菌）的体外抗菌效果。通过吸收光谱和粘度测量研究了配合物与小牛胸腺DNA的结合。为了探索铜（II）螯合物的对接研究，使用了SARS-CoV-2活性位点蛋白（PDB ID:6XBH）的晶体结构（COVID-19）以及乳腺癌突变体（PDB ID: 3hb5）。
